message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts: The defendant operated forklift without certification, wood veneer fell, killed a worker. He called police, attempted rescue, later settlement and compensation, victim's relatives forgave. The relevant crime likely is "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) under Chinese criminal law, i.e., "过失致人死亡罪". Also possibly "非法操作特种设备罪"? Forklift is a special equipment? In Chinese law, operating a forklift without qualification may be "未取得特种设备作业证书" leading to "违反安全管理规定，致人死亡" which is still covered under "过失致人死亡罪". Also maybe "交通肇事罪"? But forklift is not a vehicle on road. So main crime: "过失致人死亡罪". Also possibly "非法经营特种设备" but not indicated. So answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡罪<eoa>
